प्र-√ चिन्त् P. -चिन्तयति, to think upon, reflect, consider, find out, devise, contrive, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
1. प्र-˚चिन्त्य ind. having reflected or considered, MBh.
2. प्र-˚चिन्त्य mfn. to be r˚ or c˚, ib.
प्र-˚चिन्वत् mfn. gathering, collecting, plucking, MBh.; Hariv.
प्र-˚चिन्वत् m. N. of a son of Janam-ejaya, Hariv.; Pur.

प्र-√ चित् P. Ā. -चिकेत्ति, -चिकित्ते, to know or make known, RV.; to become visible or manifest, appear, ib.; TS. : Caus. -चेतयति, to make known, cause to appear, RV.; (Ā.) to appear, ib. : Desid. -चिकित्सति, to show, point out, ib.

v: tri॰ pra + karmaRi kta । 1 kftapracayane puzpAdO svArTe ka tatrArTe । 2 pracayasvarayukte tri॰ । saMjYAyAM kan । daRqakaBede “pracitakasamaBiDo DIraDIBiH smfto daRqakI nadvayAdurttarEH” vf॰ ra॰ ।
m: प्र-˚चित mfn. gathered, collected, heaped, accumulated

a: प्रचित — p. p. 1 Gathered, collected, plucked. --2 Amassed, accumulated. --3 Covered, filled. --4 Accentless (अनुदात्त).

m: प्र-˚चोदन n. instigating, exciting, MBh.
direction, order, command, R.
a rule or law, W.
saying, ib.

a: प्रचोदनं — 1 Driving onward, urging, inciting. --2 Instigating, setting on. --3 Ordering, enjoining, prescribing. --4 A rule, precept, order, commandment. --5 Saying. --6 Sending, despatching.

m: प्र-˚चोदिका f. ‘inflamer’, N. of the 4 daughters of Niyojikā (daughter of the demon Duḥ-saha), MārkP.

a: प्रचोदिन् — a. Driving on, urging &c. --नी A prickly nightshade.

m: प्र-˚चोदिनी f. Solanum Jacquini, L.

decreed, determined, BhP.
announced, proclaimed, ŚvetUp.
sent, dispatched, W.
a: प्रचोदित — p. p. 1 Urged, incited. --2 Instigated. --3 Directed, ordered, prescribed; Ms. 2. 191. --4 Sent, despatched. --5 Decreed, determined. --6 Announced.

m: प्र-√ चुद् P. -चोदति, to set in motion, drive on, urge, impel, RV. : Caus. -चोदयति id., RV. (Ā. to hasten, make haste, viii, 24, 13), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to excite, inspire, RV.; to command, summon, request, demand, Mn.; MBh. &c.; to announce, make known, proclaim, Mn. iii, 228.
a: प्रचुद् — {c10c} U. 1 To impel, prompt, urge, incite; चापलाय प्रचोदितः R. 1. 9. --2 To drive or urge on, push on. --3 To excite, inspire, encourage, incite, stimulate. --4 To enjoin, direct, prescribe. --5 To request, ask. --6 To fix, settle, determine. --7 To proclaim, announce.

m: प्र-˚चुदित mfn. (mc. for ˚चोदित) hurled, shot off, MBh.
प्र-चुपित See उपस्थित-प्˚.
प्रचुरी in comp. for ˚र.
प्रचुरी—√ भू to become abundant, increase, Śiś.
a: प्रचुरीभू — {c1c} P. To become plentiful, increase.

m: प्रचुरी—करण n. making abundant, augmenting, increasing, W.
a: प्रचुरीकरणं — Adding to, increasing.

m: प्रचुरी—कृत mfn. augmented, increased, ib.
a: प्रचुरीकृत — a. Augmented, increased.

plenteous, plentiful, frequent
(ifc.) abounding in, filled with, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
प्रचुर m. a thief, A.
a: प्रचुर — a. 1 Much, ample, abundant, plentiful; नित्यव्यया प्रचुरनित्यधनागमा च Bh. 2. 47; Śi. 12. 72. --2 Great, large, extensive; प्रचुरपुरंदरधनुः Gīt. 2. --3 (At the end of comp.) Abounding in, filled or replete with. --रः A thief. --Comp. --पुरुष a. populous. --(षः) a thief.

m: प्रचुर—च्छल mfn. hidden in manifold disguises, MBh.
प्रचुर—चन्दन n. much sandal, Ṛtus.

प्रचुर—नित्य-धनागम mfn. receiving many and constant supplies of money, Bhartṛ.
प्रचुर—पादप mfn. abounding with trees, R.
प्रचुर—परिभव m. frequent humiliation, ib.

m: प्रचुर—पुरुष mfn. abounding with men, populous, W.

प्रचुर—ता f. (Var.) abundance, multitude.
a: प्रचुरता --त्वं — 1 Abundance, plenty, copiousness. --2 Multitude, quantity.

withdrawal, Kap., Sch.
advancement, improvement, MW.
a: प्रच्यवः — 1 Fall, ruin, --2 Improve ment, advancement, growth. --3 Withdrawal.

m: प्र-˚च्यवन mfn. removing, destroying, Car. (w.r. for ˚च्यावन?)
प्र-˚च्यवन n. falling down (esp. from heaven i.e. being born again), HPariś.
departure, withdrawal, Suśr.
loss, deprivation (with abl.), MBh.
oozing, dropping, A.
a: प्रच्यवनं — 1 Departing, retreating, withdrawal. --2 Loss, deprivation. --3 Oozing, dropping (क्षरण).

m: प्र-√ च्यु Ā. -च्यवते (ep. also P. ˚ति), to move, proceed, depart, TS.; AV.; ŚBr.; to swerve or deviate from (abl.), MBh.; to be deprived of, lose (abl.), ib.; Kāv.; Pañcat.; to come or stream forth, ib.; to fall down, drop, stumble, ŚBr.; MBh.; R.; to fall (scil. from heaven i.e. be born again), HPariś. : Caus. -च्यावयति, to move, shake, RV.; to eject, remove or dispel or divert from (abl.), ib. &c. &c.; to cause to fall (lit. and fig.), MBh.; Daś.; BhP.; Suśr.
a: प्रच्यु — {c1c} A. 1 To move away, go away, withdraw, retreat. --2 To fall off from, drop down, fall down. --3 To forsake, abandon (as religion). --4 To be ejected or driven, be dislodged, be deprived of, lose (with abl.). --5 To flow out, stream forth. --6 To drive, urge on. --Caus. 1 To move, shake. --2 To displace, dislodge, eject, expel. --3 To cause to fall, ruin.

m: प्र-˚च्युत (प्र-) mfn. routed, put to flight expelled, banished, retreated, AV.
(प्र-) streamed forth or issued from (abl.), ib.; MBh. &c.
(प्र-) fallen from (lit. and fig.), swerved from, deprived of (abl. or comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
(प्र-) subtracted, Bījag.
a: प्रच्युत — p. p. 1 Fallen off or from. --2 Strayed, deviated. --3 Dislodged, displaced, degraded. --4 Displaced, ejected. --5 Banished, expelled. --6 Routed, put to flight.

m: प्र-˚च्युत—त्व (प्र-) n. deviation, retreat, MW.
प्र-˚च्युति f. going away, withdrawing, departing, Śaṃk.
loss, deprivation (with abl.), ib.
falling from, giving up (ifc.), Var., Sch.
decay, fall, ruin (अ-प्र्˚), ŚBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.
a: प्रच्युतिः — f. 1 Departing, withdrawal. --2 Loss, deprivation, falling down from; नित्यं प्रच्युतिशंकया क्षणमपि स्वर्गे न मोदामहे Śānti. 4. 20. --3 Fall, ruin.
